entities.summary: Chelsea Aubry is a Canadian professional basketball player from Kitchener, Ontario. She plays for the Canadian women's national basketball team. She has competed in the 2012 Summer Olympics. She is 1.88 m tall. She has played for Bendigo Spirit.
